class.name: mmr_rviz_plugins/SpeedProfile
class.description: Visualizes mmr_base/msg/SpeedProfilePoints as a colored trajectory: a sphere per waypoint (blue=slow, red=fast) connected by a path line. The message has no Header, so the reference TF frame is chosen in the display.

class.name: mmr_rviz_plugins/BoundedPointCloud
class.description: Visualizes mmr_base/msg/BoundedPointcloud by converting it directly inside RViz2. The message has no Header, so the reference TF frame is chosen in the display.
